intro: This quest tasks Horde warlocks with reuniting the severed halves of the ancient Tome of the Cabal for Jorah Annison in the Undercity. Once kept within the kingdom of Lordaeron, the grimoire was torn apart and scattered across the world before being lost entirely. Tracking down its damp and tattered remnants requires braving hostile waters in the Eastern Kingdoms and deep centaur territory in Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah! I see that you are a warlock of similar tastes to mine. Indeed, acquiring the Tome of the Cabal is a worthy aspiration. Did you know that it was once held within the walls of Lordaeron? It was vandalized though, almost half its pages removed. Who would commit such a heinous act?
That half is lost, though rumor says that it fell into the hands of the centaur of the Thousand Needles.
The rest of the text was to be transferred to Ironforge, but was lost in transit on the coast west of Southshore.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It may be that you are chasing after fairy tales,friend, but truth can be found at the center of even the wildest rumors.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well well well! What do we have here?
This is impressive, friend. I wouldn't have thought it possible, but here it is in my very hands, the complete Tome of the Cabal.
Allow me to leaf through its pages for just a moment before you are off again.
